title: Mưa trên kính
about: Round 15, in the mo-ao style after the user's new reference: E minor at 104 bpm, its tune low (G3-E5) in halves and quarters so it feels half as fast, diminished colour (A#dim7, F#m7b5) and a bass falling E-D-C, a shimmer trembling above it where it swells; an original tune.
